links.outcome: Subgroup performance of stroke outcome prediction by sex, age, thrombectomy status, and summary length
links.effect: Consistent performance across sex and age, but higher error among older patients, those undergoing thrombectomy, and those with longer summaries.
links.quote: Subgroup analyses showed consistent performance across sex and age, with higher error among older patients, those undergoing thrombectomy and those with longer summaries.

unlisted_practices: Two-step chain-of-thought reasoning framework with open-source LLM for outcome prediction from unstructured notes
Using locally run open-source lightweight LLMs for privacy preservation

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an LLM reasoning framework (COPE) for predicting 90-day stroke outcomes from clinical notes compared against other models, without evaluating a specific operational deployment practice or guardrail.
